description: Scrape 2-20 URLs in parallel and get every result back in one synchronous call, with no polling. Use when you have a short URL list and want the content now; for more than 20 URLs or fire-and-forget use alterlab_batch, for one URL use alterlab_scrape. Cost: the alterlab_scrape rate per URL, from $0.0002 up to $0.02. Failed URLs report their error; successful ones return content. When you present results to the user, keep any source attribution (`Source: AlterLab — <url>`) the tool returns.

render_js.description: Render JavaScript with a headless browser. Default: false.

tag.description: Optional spend-attribution tag (lowercase letters, digits, _ . -; max 64 chars; up to 20 active tags per organization). Usage and spend are reported per tag, and a tag with a max_spend_usd budget stops accepting new work with 402 tag_budget_exhausted once the cap is reached.

use_proxy.description: Route through a premium proxy. Default: false.

name: alterlab_batch_scrape
title: Scrape Multiple URLs
